content.short: GoTyme Bank is a Philippine digital bank pairing an app with in-store kiosks for accounts, cards and savings.
content.description: GoTyme Bank is a digital bank in the Philippines, a joint venture between the Gokongwei Group and the Tyme group that pairs an app-based experience with physical onboarding kiosks in malls and retail stores. It offers fee-free savings and deposit accounts, a debit card, high-interest savings and rewards tied to the Gokongwei network of retail and travel brands, aimed at Filipinos underserved or frustrated by traditional banks. By combining human-assisted sign-up with a fully digital everyday banking experience, GoTyme has grown quickly among consumers seeking accessible accounts, cards and savings. It competes with other Philippine digital banks for the country's fast-digitizing retail market.
